en_title: ‘I’m Shocked That People Are Still Playing’ – How GTA 5 Took Over the World
subtitle: 不止是犯罪模拟器
opus_summary: 《GTA5》销量超过2.3亿份，成为玩家竞速、表演特技与拍摄影片的虚拟世界。开发者与玩家回顾它及线上模式的演变，也谈到续作面世后，这个庞大社区将何去何从。

paragraphs.en: There are over 230 million copies of Grand Theft Auto 5 in the world. As the second-highest selling game of all time, it has been played for billions of hours by players across the globe, making it one of the most significant pastimes in the entire world. That’s an impressive achievement for what in 2013 was simply the highly-anticipated next entry in Rockstar’s beloved (and notorious) open-world crime series. But GTA 5 proved to be much, much more than a typical sequel. It has become home to a huge, expressive, and loyal community, one which has made a digital hobby of everything from warring alien clans to producing slick vehicle stunt movies.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA5》在全球的销量已超过2.3亿份。作为史上销量第二高的游戏，全球玩家在其中投入了数十亿小时，让它成为世界上最重要的消遣方式之一。这样的成就令人惊叹，毕竟在2013年，它还只是Rockstar旗下备受喜爱（也恶名远扬）的开放世界犯罪系列中，一部万众期待的新作。但《GTA5》远远不止是一部普通续作。它成了一个庞大、富有表现力且忠诚的社区的家园。在这里，玩家把各种活动变成了数字世界中的爱好，从外星人帮派大战，到制作精良的载具特技影片，不一而足。

paragraphs.en: This is the story of how a video game became much more than a crime simulator.
paragraphs.cn: 这个故事讲述的是，一款电子游戏如何远远超越犯罪模拟器的范畴。

paragraphs.en: Ash Skyqueen’s avatar weaves between the traffic of busy Dorset Drive on a motorbike spouting flames. Suddenly she veers, mounting the pavement at high speed and rebounding from the roof of a bus stop to achieve incredible air. Momentum carries her through a perfect circle, barely bigger than a human body, that forms the second ‘O’ of the ‘LIQUOR HOLE’ store sign. Pulling the ripcord of her parachute, she lands with a slight stagger at the door of the rundown booze establishment on Eclipse Boulevard - a couple of streets over from where her jump began.
paragraphs.cn: Ash Skyqueen操控的角色骑着一辆喷着火焰的摩托车，在繁忙的多塞特车道上穿梭于车流之间。突然，她猛地转向，高速冲上人行道，借公交站顶棚跃起，腾空高度惊人。惯性带着她穿过一个正圆形的孔洞，它只比人体略大，正是「LIQUOR HOLE」商店招牌中的第二个字母「O」。她拉开降落伞，落地时稍稍踉跄了一下，停在日蚀大道上一家破旧酒铺的门口——这里距离她起跳的地方隔着几条街。

paragraphs.en: It’s the first feat in a stunt montage which Ash put together to celebrate ten years of GTA 5 – the game that gave her freedom, companionship and goals when she was robbed of all three. “I’d had a ruptured disc in my spine, so I was bed bound shortly after the game came out,” she says. “All day every day for about three years straight, it became my therapy in a way. You’re stuck in bed, can’t do anything, can’t work, no social life, a pretty miserable existence. And then I’m suddenly connected to a community of people doing the same thing. It kept me from going insane.”
paragraphs.cn: 这是Ash为庆祝《GTA5》十周年制作的特技集锦中的第一个惊险动作。当她失去自由、陪伴和目标时，正是这款游戏把这三样东西带回了她的生活。她说：「我的椎间盘破裂了，所以游戏发售后不久，我就只能卧床。大约连续三年，我每天从早到晚都在玩，从某种意义上说，它成了我的治疗方式。你困在床上，什么都做不了，没法工作，没有社交生活，日子相当难熬。然后，我突然和一群做着同样事情的人建立了联系。它让我没有发疯。」

paragraphs.en: It’s a striking demonstration of why GTA 5 has remained a deeply important game to millions of players. A pillar of pop culture, it was erected in 2013 and has loomed over the entertainment industries during every year since. Thanks to the enduring love for its single-player story campaign and its ever-popular, seemingly invincible online mode, GTA 5 has spanned three console generations and made around $10 billion dollars for publisher Take-Two – over 3 times more than the highest-grossing movie ever. When Shawn Levy and Ryan Reynolds made Free Guy, a Hollywood comedy about the social connection and wanton violence of online games, it was GTA they chose to riff on.
paragraphs.cn: 这段经历生动地说明了，为什么《GTA5》对数百万玩家而言，始终是一款意义重大的游戏。它在2013年成为流行文化的一根支柱，此后每一年都在娱乐行业中占据着举足轻重的地位。玩家对单人剧情战役的喜爱经久不衰，而在线模式也始终大受欢迎，似乎无人能够撼动。凭借这两点，《GTA5》横跨三代主机，为发行商Take-Two带来了约100亿美元(约合人民币670亿元)的收入，超过影史票房最高电影的三倍。Shawn Levy和瑞安·雷诺兹拍摄《失控玩家》时，选择了以《侠盗猎车手》为蓝本。这部好莱坞喜剧讲述了网络游戏中的社交联系与肆意暴力。

paragraphs.en: Where previous Grand Theft Auto entries were cinema-riffing crime simulators that routinely broke sales records, GTA 5 has evolved beyond those confines. It has become an alternate world where players can escape to a funhouse mirror version of LA – the most mythologised city on the planet. There they become whoever they want to be: stunt specialist, bank robber, nightclub kid, hitchhiker or filmmaker.
paragraphs.cn: 过去的《侠盗猎车手》作品是借鉴电影的犯罪模拟游戏，经常打破销量纪录，而《GTA5》已经突破了这些界限。它变成了另一个世界，玩家可以逃离现实，来到一个如哈哈镜般夸张变形的洛杉矶——这座地球上最富传奇色彩的城市。在那里，他们可以成为任何自己想成为的人：特技高手、银行劫匪、夜店玩家、搭便车的旅人，或是电影制作人。

paragraphs.en: In some ways, GTA 5 was a course correction for Rockstar. While 2008’s Grand Theft Auto 4 had been rapturously received, it was a narrower interpretation of what the series could be. Some players chafed against its dour and grounded tone, as well as the unforgiving driving simulation that threatened to hurl speeding players through the windscreen. It was a largely straight-faced vision that left a space for rivals like Saints Row developer Volition, who filled the vacuum with gleefully absurd city sandboxes populated by dildo-toting gangsters and gimp chariots.
paragraphs.cn: 从某些方面来看，《GTA5》是Rockstar对系列方向的一次调整。2008年的《侠盗猎车手4》虽然广受赞誉，但它对系列可能性的诠释更为局限。有些玩家不喜欢它阴郁、写实的基调，也不喜欢那套容错率极低的模拟驾驶机制——车速过快，玩家就可能被甩出挡风玻璃。这种总体上严肃、不苟言笑的风格，给《黑道圣徒》开发商Volition等竞争对手留下了空间。它们用荒诞得令人乐在其中的城市沙盒填补了空白，里面既有挥舞着假阳具的黑帮成员，也有由穿着性虐装的人拉动的战车。

paragraphs.en: GTA 5, however, saw Rockstar reclaim its lost territory in the single-player space without compromising its serious storytelling chops. The developer turned up all the dials on its screaming satire, filling its campaign missions with ludicrous plane, train, and helicopter setpieces in which the bodies hit the floor without moral consequence. The driving was made friendlier, and the oppressive skyscrapers of GTA 4 replaced by the open freeways of the San Andreas countryside. Yet GTA 5 also told the ambitious tale of three controllable protagonists at totally different points in their lives – Franklin, the young and hungry Scarface-in-waiting; Michael, the washed-up cuckold; and Trevor, the psychopathic embodiment of the five-star Wanted level.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，《GTA5》让Rockstar收复了在单人游戏领域失去的阵地，同时没有牺牲其严肃叙事的功力。开发团队将尖锐讽刺的力度全面拉满，在战役任务中安排了飞机、火车和直升机参与的荒唐大场面，角色大开杀戒也不必承担道德后果。驾驶变得更容易上手，《GTA4》中压抑的摩天大楼也被圣安地列斯乡间开阔的高速公路取代。但《GTA5》同样讲述了一个雄心勃勃的故事，围绕三位处在人生截然不同阶段的可操控主角展开：富兰克林年轻而野心勃勃，仿佛是尚未发迹的「疤面煞星」；迈克尔风光不再，还被戴了绿帽；崔佛则是五星通缉等级的化身，一个精神变态。

paragraphs.en: As clear as that ambition is to see in the final product, Mike York had nothing close to a sense of that full picture when he first joined the GTA 5 development team as an animator, two and a half years before its launch.
paragraphs.cn: 成品中的这份雄心清晰可见，但Mike York在游戏发售前两年半以动画师的身份加入《GTA5》开发团队时，对这幅完整蓝图几乎毫无概念。

paragraphs.en: “A lot of times during production you’re thrown in there, and you don’t know what the story is and how it plays out,” he says. “There are a lot of scenes where I didn’t even know what came before or after. I was so out of the loop with the story of the game. They just threw me a cutscene with Tanisha and Franklin and were like, ‘Hey, can you do the body animation on this?’ But I had no idea how it connected. All I knew is, ‘Damn, this girl looks mad at Franklin. She looks like she just broke up with him.’”
paragraphs.cn: 「开发过程中，你经常就这么被拉去干活，既不知道故事讲的是什么，也不知道情节会如何发展，」他说。「很多场景，我甚至不知道前后发生了什么。我对游戏剧情实在太不了解了。他们直接丢给我一段塔妮莎和富兰克林的过场动画，说：「嘿，你能做一下这段的身体动画吗？」但我完全不知道这段与其他情节有什么联系。我只知道：「靠，这姑娘看起来很生富兰克林的气。她看起来像是刚跟他分手。」」

paragraphs.en: Even in the final six months of development, when members of the team were “all hands on deck” and testing the game for eight hours every day, it was impossible to perceive GTA 5 in its entirety.
paragraphs.cn: 即使到了开发的最后六个月，团队成员「全员上阵」，每天测试游戏八小时，也依然无法了解《GTA5》的全貌。

paragraphs.en: “As a tester, you’re trying to play through the whole game over and over and over again,” York says. “But the game is very long. A lot of times I would play the game from the very beginning, up until 60% or 70%, and then a new build of the game would come out where they fixed a bunch of bugs. And so I only played the game from start to finish all the way one time, and that was after I was done from the project and played it at my house by myself.”
paragraphs.cn: 「作为测试人员，你要试着一遍又一遍地打完整款游戏，」York说。「但游戏流程非常长。很多时候，我会从头开始玩，玩到60%或70%，开发团队就会推出一个修复了大量漏洞的新版本。所以，我只从头到尾完整打通过一次，那还是在我结束这个项目的工作之后，自己在家里玩的。」

paragraphs.en: Only then could York finally appreciate the enormous puzzle he’d been contributing pieces to for so long. “I think the biggest thing I was shocked about was how massive it was, how big the world was, and how cool the system was of being able to switch characters,” he says. “I thought that was unique, and I knew that players hadn’t seen that before.” It’s a system that Rockstar’s peers in the triple-A sphere are only now catching up to - infusing Spider-Man 2 and Assassin’s Creed Shadows with swappable protagonists whose stories are entwined.
paragraphs.cn: 直到那时，York才终于得以看清这幅庞大的拼图全貌，而他此前一直在为它添上一个个碎片。他说：「最让我震惊的，我想还是游戏的规模有多大、世界有多广阔，以及能切换角色的系统有多酷。我觉得这很独特，也知道玩家此前没见过这样的设计。」直到如今，其他3A厂商才开始赶上Rockstar，在《蜘蛛侠2》和《刺客信条：影》中加入可切换的主角，让他们的故事彼此交织。

paragraphs.en: As an American, York appreciated Rockstar North’s Scottish perspective - an outsider’s view of the quirks and comedy inherent in LA culture. “I think they have a pretty good eye, a good touch on our society,” he says. “And that’s because, even though the main studio is in Edinburgh, a lot of the people that work there are from the US, or all they do is watch US TV shows and play US games. They’re engulfed in our culture in general. So even though they live in the UK, they have a good pulse on everything that’s going around here.”
paragraphs.cn: 身为美国人，York很欣赏Rockstar North的苏格兰视角：他们从局外人的角度，观察洛杉矶文化中固有的古怪之处与喜剧色彩。他说：「我觉得他们很善于观察我们的社会，也很懂得如何呈现它。这是因为，虽然主工作室位于爱丁堡，但那里很多员工都来自美国，或者整天都在看美国电视剧、玩美国游戏。总的来说，他们完全沉浸在我们的文化中。所以，即使他们住在英国，也能很好地把握这里发生的一切。」

paragraphs.en: When the midnight launch came, Ash Skyqueen and her sister stood in line at the Metrocentre shopping mall in the north-east of England. Like so many others, she took the game home and pushed it straight into the console. Behind the scenes, the development team were “stoked, walking around the office and telling people, ‘Oh my God, did you see we just sold this many?’ There were a lot of funny comments from people on YouTube channels and we were all geeking out about that.”
paragraphs.cn: 午夜发售时，Ash Skyqueen和姐姐在英格兰东北部的Metrocentre购物中心排队。和许多人一样，她把游戏带回家后，立刻就将光盘放进了主机。在幕后，开发团队则「兴奋不已，在办公室里四处走动，跟大家说：「天哪，你看到我们刚卖出了多少份吗？」YouTube频道上有很多有趣的评论，我们都兴奋地聊着这些。」

paragraphs.en: Simultaneously, however, Rockstar was readying to launch GTA Online - the platform that would take Los Santos multiplayer. “We were trying to get prepared for that, too,” York says. “So half of it is excitement, and the other half is trying to get some stuff done for Online.”
paragraphs.cn: 不过与此同时，Rockstar也在准备推出《GTA Online》，让玩家能在洛圣都展开多人游戏。York说：「我们也在努力为此做好准备。所以我们一边兴奋，一边还得赶着把《GTA Online》的一些工作做完。」

paragraphs.en: GTA Online arrived only two weeks after its parent game and immediately ran into problems. There were difficulties with servers, crashes and lost character progress. The IGN review of the time criticised the repetitive missions and oddly mute player avatars, who contributed little to cutscenes with established GTA characters like Trevor. “I’m left with the overbearing impression,” wrote Keza MacDonald, “that Grand Theft Auto Online as it stands right now is still a colour sketch of what it will probably one day become.”
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA Online》仅比本体晚两周上线，却立刻遇到了问题：服务器故障、游戏崩溃，以及角色进度丢失。当时的IGN评测批评了重复的任务，以及玩家角色莫名其妙地一言不发——在与崔佛等《侠盗猎车手》已有角色共同出场的过场动画中，玩家角色几乎没什么表现。Keza MacDonald写道：「我最强烈的感受是，就目前的状态而言，《GTA Online》仍只是一幅彩色草图，勾勒着它将来可能成为的模样。」

paragraphs.en: In 2017, Rockstar’s then director of design, Imran Sarwar, offered an unusually frank assessment of GTA Online’s formative period. “To be totally honest it did not begin very well at all,” he told Game Informer . “It’s one of our biggest regrets that we lost millions of players in that first year that have never experienced how much we have improved and added to the game since the early days.”
paragraphs.cn: 2017年，时任Rockstar设计总监Imran Sarwar对《GTA Online》初期的表现给出了罕见的坦率评价。他告诉Game Informer：「完全坦白地说，它的开局一点都不好。我们最大的遗憾之一，就是在第一年流失了数百万玩家，他们从未体验过我们在游戏推出初期之后做出的诸多改进和新增内容。」

paragraphs.en: Rockstar had promised players cooperative heists – huge multistage missions featuring lavish story sequences in the mode of single-player GTA. But the company’s first attempts didn’t live up to its own standards and had to be redesigned from scratch, leading to several delays.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar曾向玩家承诺推出合作抢劫任务：这些大型任务分为多个阶段，并包含如《侠盗猎车手》单人模式那般精心制作的剧情演出。但公司的最初尝试未能达到自己的标准，只得从头重新设计，导致多次延期。

paragraphs.en: “GTA Online was slowly failing - and quickly losing players - right up until the middle of 2014,” Sarwar said. “The updates were not interesting enough, and as a company we did not realise how challenging it was going to be to have a team that essentially ran a content service, not make normal games.”
paragraphs.cn: Sarwar说：「直到2014年年中，《GTA Online》都在逐渐走向失败，玩家也在迅速流失。更新内容不够有趣，而我们公司也没有意识到，让一支团队主要负责运营内容服务，而不是制作常规游戏，会有多大的挑战。」

paragraphs.en: This is not the obvious oversight it might seem today. When GTA Online launched, the live service model was in its nascency. Fortunately, as Rockstar fumbled around trying to figure out the shape of its multiplayer platform, it had a critically acclaimed single-player game to lean on. “GTA 5 helped prop up GTA Online in the early days when Rockstar was still exploring how it wanted the online component to work,” says James McWhirter, senior games analyst at Omdia. “There was a lot of experimentation going on behind the scenes.”
paragraphs.cn: 这件事在今天看来或许是个明显的疏漏，但当时并非如此。《GTA Online》上线时，持续运营模式还处于萌芽阶段。幸运的是，Rockstar在摸索多人游戏平台该是什么样子的过程中，还有一款广受好评的单人游戏作为支撑。Omdia高级游戏分析师James McWhirter说：「早期，Rockstar还在探索线上部分该如何运作，《GTA5》帮助撑起了《GTA Online》。幕后开展了大量试验。」

paragraphs.en: Some of those experiments were in economics. If there’s a comparison to be drawn, it’s Team Fortress 2 – the competitive FPS that Valve used as a testing ground for new business models that have since become standard in Counter-Strike, Dota 2, and a host of other games besides. Ultimately, GTA 5 has made its billions through multiple different methods.
paragraphs.cn: 其中一些试验涉及经济模式。要找一个可供比较的例子，那就是《军团要塞2》：Valve曾用这款竞技FPS试验新的商业模式，而这些模式如今已成为《反恐精英》《Dota2》以及许多其他游戏的常规做法。最终，《GTA5》通过多种不同方式赚取了数十亿的收入。

paragraphs.en: “It’s simultaneously pulling all of those levers,” McWhirter says. “You’ve got the upfront sales for GTA 5 itself, the full game. You’ve got in-game purchases via GTA Online, and now Rockstar have begun to lean into subscriptions with GTA+.”
paragraphs.cn: McWhirter说：「它同时运用了所有这些手段。首先是《GTA5》完整游戏本身的买断销售收入，然后是《GTA Online》的游戏内购，如今Rockstar又开始着力发展GTA+订阅服务。」

paragraphs.en: None of that would have panned out if the GTA Online team hadn’t solved its biggest creative problem: heists. As Rockstar began to update its world with unique new stories and complex missions that demanded coordination and mastery from their players, GTA Online genuinely started to look like the future of the series rather than a flawed spin-off. Even resolutely solo players braved the servers for fear of being left behind.
paragraphs.cn: 如果《GTA Online》团队没有解决最大的创作难题——抢劫任务，这一切都不会奏效。Rockstar开始为游戏世界更新独特的新故事和复杂任务，要求玩家相互配合并熟练掌握玩法。《GTA Online》也真正开始展现出这个系列未来的模样，而不再像一款有缺陷的衍生作品。就连坚持独自游玩的玩家，也因担心跟不上而硬着头皮加入了线上服务器。

paragraphs.en: “I was kind of shocked by how much extra story and missions they put into Online,” York says, who left Rockstar in 2017 – a few years before the likes of the Cayo Perico and Diamond Casino heists were added. “They really went all out, I felt, adding all kinds of stuff to do in there.”
paragraphs.cn: 「他们给线上模式增加了那么多剧情和任务，我有点震惊，」York说。他在2017年离开Rockstar，比佩里科岛和名钻赌场等抢劫任务加入游戏早了几年。「我觉得他们真的不遗余力，往里面加了各种各样可玩的内容。」

paragraphs.en: GTA Online’s turnaround and subsequent financial success came at the cost of single-player expansions. Actor Steven Ogg filmed scenes for a solo campaign that would have featured Trevor as an undercover agent, but it never emerged thanks to GTA Online sucking up many of the resources once earmarked for DLC.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA Online》扭转局面并随后在商业上取得成功，代价却是单人扩展内容。演员Steven Ogg曾为一段单人战役拍摄过场景，崔佛原本会在其中担任卧底特工。但《GTA Online》占用了大量原本留给DLC的资源，这段战役最终未能面世。

paragraphs.en: “I can’t speak for the company, obviously,” York says. “But I think that they wanted to do a little bit of both. And I think they did have strong intent with DLC stuff, but the Online just did better. That happens a lot at studios, where they’ll have a DLC lined up that they’ll have plans for, and then they’ll completely shut it down because they realise something else is way more important - or they don’t even know if that DLC is going to perform well at all. They’d rather just not take the risk on it.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我当然不能代表公司发言，」York说。「但我觉得他们当时想两边都做一点。我也觉得他们确实很想做DLC，只是线上模式的表现更好。工作室里经常发生这种事：他们安排了DLC，也有了计划，随后却把它彻底取消，因为他们发现别的内容重要得多——或者他们根本不知道那个DLC能不能取得好成绩。他们宁愿不冒这个险。」

paragraphs.en: GTA Online effectively took the place of traditional expansions, becoming an endgame for solo players who had exhausted every mission and diversion in GTA 5. Unusually for newcomers to an MMO, they arrived with dozens of hours of investment in its world and characters. “You know the map and where the streets are,” York says. “You finally get your own character.”
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA Online》实际上取代了传统扩展内容，让那些已经玩遍《GTA5》所有任务和消遣活动的单人玩家有了通关后继续游玩的去处。与一般初入MMO的玩家不同，这些玩家此前已经在这个世界及其角色身上投入了数十个小时。「你熟悉地图，也知道街道在哪儿，」York说。「你终于有了自己的角色。」

paragraphs.en: “I played it like a single-player expansion at first,” Ash Skyqueen says. “Played through everything I could by myself, and kept playing. The mechanics have always been what appeals, so it was easy to sit there and figure out what I could do.”
paragraphs.cn: 「一开始，我把它当成单人扩展内容来玩，」Ash Skyqueen说。「我把所有能独自完成的内容都玩了一遍，然后继续玩下去。吸引我的一直是玩法机制，所以我很容易就能坐下来，琢磨自己可以做些什么。」

paragraphs.en: It’s with this spirit of exploration that GTA’s developers and players outgrew the limitations of the series’ original premise. “The more comfortable we were pushing beyond the traditional GTA concepts and experimenting more freely, we were able to introduce things like Cunning Stunts, the Special Vehicle Races, and adversary modes like Power Play, Tiny Racers, or Slasher,” Sarwar told Game Informer .
paragraphs.cn: 正是凭着这种探索精神，《侠盗猎车手》的开发者和玩家突破了系列最初设定的局限。「我们越是敢于突破《侠盗猎车手》的传统概念，更自由地尝试，就越能推出《狂野特技》（Cunning Stunts）、特殊载具竞速（Special Vehicle Races），以及力量争夺（Power Play）、迷你车手（Tiny Racers）或杀戮（Slasher）这样的对抗模式，」Sarwar向Game Informer表示。

paragraphs.en: The backdrop of Los Santos, recognisable as a contemporary city only slightly adjacent to our own world, proved helpfully malleable. “One of the updates GTA Online brought in was a TrackMania style game, racing in the cloud with a top-down perspective, almost like Micro Machines,” McWhirter says. “That just wouldn’t have been possible in Red Dead Redemption. Anything with a real world analog can be realised in GTA Online, so it’s a much more potent canvas for content updates over a long period of time. Whereas Red Dead is a lot more tied to its fiction. You couldn’t have flying horses, like having flying cars added to GTA Online.”
paragraphs.cn: 洛圣都一看就是一座现代城市，与现实世界只有些许差异。这种背景很容易灵活调整，为游戏带来了便利。McWhirter说：「《GTA Online》有一次更新加入了类似《TrackMania》的玩法，让玩家以俯视视角在云端赛车，几乎就像《Micro Machines》。这在《荒野大镖客：救赎》里根本不可能实现。只要现实世界中有对应的事物，就能在《GTA Online》里实现，所以它更适合长期推出内容更新。相比之下，《荒野大镖客》受到自身虚构设定的限制要大得多。你不能往里面加入会飞的马，却可以给《GTA Online》加入会飞的汽车。」

paragraphs.en: That flexibility has enabled Rockstar to transform GTA into a platform for many different kinds of experiences, capable of holding player attention indefinitely. “Similar to Minecraft or Fortnite, it’s a virtual world first and foremost, and a game second,” McWhirter says. “In terms of GTA Online, the racing updates with the crazy track editors are a good example of how content that could perhaps normally make for a standalone game became a bolt-on for GTA Online.”
paragraphs.cn: 这种灵活性让Rockstar得以将《侠盗猎车手》变成承载多种不同体验的平台，能够一直吸引玩家的注意力。McWhirter说：「与《我的世界》或《堡垒之夜》类似，它首先是一个虚拟世界，其次才是一款游戏。《GTA Online》的竞速更新就是个很好的例子，其中的赛道编辑器能做出各种疯狂的赛道。这些内容通常或许足以做成一款独立游戏，却成了《GTA Online》的附加内容。」

paragraphs.en: Over time, these bolt-ons have replaced smaller game releases in Rockstar’s catalogue, for better or worse. “I would consider GTA Online to be the modern day equivalent of the double-A titles that Take-Two used to push out between those blockbuster games,” McWhirter says. “If we go back to the PS3 and 360 generation, there were games like Rockstar Games Presents Table Tennis and Bully, which we don’t really see anymore because teams are busy making content for GTA Online instead. Because that’s more valuable for the publisher. It helps them buy time between major GTA releases.”
paragraphs.cn: 随着时间推移，不论好坏，这些附加内容已经取代了Rockstar原本会推出的小体量游戏。McWhirter说：「我认为，《GTA Online》相当于如今的2A级作品，过去Take-Two会在那些重磅大作之间推出这类游戏。回到PS3和XBOX 360世代，当时有《Rockstar Games Presents Table Tennis》和《恶霸鲁尼》这样的游戏，如今我们基本看不到了，因为团队转而忙着为《GTA Online》制作内容。这对发行商来说更有价值，能帮他们争取时间，填补《侠盗猎车手》系列大作之间的空档。」

paragraphs.en: For players like Ash Skyqueen, a new content drop in GTA Online serves a dual purpose. Beyond the extra heists and missions to play through, every update is a toy box filled with fresh animations and props to be repurposed in fan-made movies.
paragraphs.cn: 对于Ash Skyqueen这样的玩家来说，《GTA Online》每次推出新内容都有双重用途。除了能玩到更多抢劫任务和其他任务，每次更新还像一个玩具箱，装满了新的动画和道具，可以用来制作粉丝电影。

paragraphs.en: Skyqueen got into making machinima through her community of stunters, who made use of a modding tool named MenyooSP. “It gives you access to everything,” she says. “I can set up a secondary character, give it a list of actions and animations to carry out, and then manually control my character and do what I need to do.”
paragraphs.cn: Skyqueen是在自己所属的特技玩家社区里开始接触游戏电影制作的。这个社区的玩家使用一款名为MenyooSP的模组工具。她说：「它让你能调用所有东西。我可以设置另一个角色，给它安排一系列动作和动画，然后手动控制我自己的角色，完成我需要做的事。」

paragraphs.en: In her own movies, Skyqueen is star, stuntperson and director - the latter role enabled by the official video editor Rockstar added to GTA 5 back in 2015. One of her most popular creations, the silent short film Siren , evokes the intro cutscene of GTA 3 – following a Bonnie and Clyde-esque couple who wreak havoc as the FIB closes in. In the climax, a pre-programmed prison bus travels down the freeway - before Ash swings in on her bike to take down the convoy.
paragraphs.cn: 在自己的电影里，Skyqueen既是主演，也是特技演员和导演。她能担任导演，靠的是Rockstar在2015年为《GTA5》加入的官方视频编辑器。她最受欢迎的作品之一是无声短片《Siren》，让人联想到《GTA3》的开场过场动画：一对类似邦妮与克莱德的情侣四处作乱，FIB则步步逼近。影片的高潮部分，一辆预先设定好行动的囚车沿高速公路行驶，随后Ash骑着摩托车冲入，击溃了车队。

paragraphs.en: “There’s a lot of choreography involved,” she says. “I’ll often just sit there with a nine-hour long YouTube video of all the GTA story cutscenes, keeping my eye out for something that I can use in a different context.”
paragraphs.cn: 「这需要大量的动作编排，」她说，「我经常就坐在那里，看YouTube上一段长达九小时、收录了《侠盗猎车手》所有剧情过场动画的视频，留意有没有能放到不同情境中使用的素材。」

paragraphs.en: 180,000 viewers have watched Siren. Almost a million people have watched her Liqour Hole stunt . And Skyqueen hopes Rockstar will implement some of MenyooSP’s innovations officially in GTA 6. “I know they take note of this kind of stuff, and they certainly have promoted work that’s been made with it.”
paragraphs.cn: 已有18万人观看了《Siren》，她的Liqour Hole特技视频则吸引了近百万人观看。Skyqueen希望Rockstar能在《GTA6》中正式加入MenyooSP的一些创新功能。「我知道他们会关注这类东西，而且他们确实推广过用它制作的作品。」

paragraphs.en: The ongoing success of GTA 5 raises questions about its eventual fate, once Rockstar’s sequel launches in November 2026. Will the studio run two versions of GTA Online simultaneously, at the risk of cannibalising its own playerbase? If not, and the GTA Online audience is migrated to a new Floridian setting, how will Rockstar account for all the properties and vehicles players have paid for?
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA5》持续取得成功，也让人不禁追问：等到Rockstar的续作于2026年11月推出后，这款游戏最终会何去何从？工作室会冒着分流自家玩家的风险，同时运营两个版本的《GTA Online》吗？如果不会，而是将《GTA Online》的玩家迁移到以佛罗里达为背景的新地图，Rockstar又将如何处理玩家花钱购买的所有房产和载具？

paragraphs.en: “If a new online mode is a completely separate thing from GTA 5 Online, managing continuously between two live service games is something that is currently unproven and it could be fraught,” McWhirter says. “I think that’s probably the biggest risk for them.” The situation brings to mind the arrival of EverQuest 2 in the mid noughties, when developer Sony Online Entertainment discovered that players typically played just one MMO and stuck with it. In such a context, a sequel’s biggest threat can be its own predecessor.
paragraphs.cn: 「如果新的线上模式与《GTA5》的线上模式完全独立，那么同时持续运营两款服务型游戏，目前还没有经过验证，可能会遇到不少麻烦，」McWhirter说，「我想，这大概是他们面临的最大风险。」这让人想起2000年代中期《无尽的任务2》推出时的情形。当时，开发商索尼在线娱乐发现，玩家通常只玩一款MMO，而且会一直玩下去。在这种情况下，续作最大的威胁可能恰恰是前作。

paragraphs.en: “I think GTA 5 is going to solidify as one of the greatest games in history,” York says. “I think its legacy is already etched. It was revolutionary in so many aspects - in character switching and story. I’m shocked that people are still playing GTA 5, and it goes to show you how good that game is.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我认为，《GTA5》作为史上最伟大游戏之一的地位会更加稳固，」York说，「我觉得它留下的影响已经不可磨灭。它在很多方面都带来了革命性的变化，包括角色切换和故事。我很惊讶，竟然还有人在玩《GTA5》，而这也足以说明这款游戏有多出色。」

paragraphs.en: While admitting to a certain amount of bias as a former member of the development team, York believes that GTA 5 will be bigger than its own sequel once the dust settles. “I feel like GTA 5 was something special in gaming culture and history, and it’s gonna leave a lasting mark,” he says. “Games will come and go around it. My intuition is that GTA 6 will come out, people will love it, but it won’t be GTA 5. And people will constantly compare it to GTA 5. It’s going to be the most nostalgic for people, it’s going to be the one that affected them most as kids. And so I just feel like GTA 5 is going to be the GTA to be remembered. It’s gonna supersede Vice City. This is the one that marked history.”
paragraphs.cn: York承认，自己曾是开发团队的一员，难免有些偏心，但他相信，等一切尘埃落定，《GTA5》的影响力会超过它的续作。「我觉得《GTA5》在游戏文化和历史中是个特别的存在，它会留下长久的印记，」他说，「其他游戏会在它身边来来去去。我的直觉是，《GTA6》推出后，人们会喜欢它，但它终究不是《GTA5》。而且，人们会不断拿它与《GTA5》比较。《GTA5》会是最让人怀念的那一作，也是他们小时候受影响最深的一作。所以我就是觉得，《GTA5》会成为人们铭记的那部《侠盗猎车手》。它会超越《侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市》。留下历史印记的，就是这一作。」

paragraphs.en: For Ash Skyqueen, who can no longer drive around a city in real life, GTA 5 is much more than a game. “It gives me that little bit of freedom back that I lost with the injury,” she says. “Though it’s simulated, it has such a good feel to it. I’ll always get on at Christmas when they turn on the snow. You’re walking around the streets at night, and it gives you that same vibe as in real life. In other games it’s just an aesthetic. But you can feel that stillness that comes with a dark snowy night. I don’t know how they do it.”
paragraphs.cn: 对现实中已无法开车在城市里穿行的Ash Skyqueen来说，《GTA5》远不止是一款游戏。她说：「受伤让我失去了自由，而它让我找回了一点。虽然是模拟出来的，但感觉真的很好。每到圣诞节，游戏里开始下雪时，我总会上线。夜里走在街上，那种氛围和现实生活中一样。在其他游戏里，雪只是视觉效果。但在这里，你能感受到漆黑雪夜里的那份寂静。我不知道他们是怎么做到的。」

paragraphs.en: Jeremy Peel is a freelance journalist and friend to anyone who will look at photos of his dogs.
paragraphs.cn: Jeremy Peel是一名自由撰稿记者，谁愿意看他家狗狗的照片，他就愿意和谁交朋友。
